name: vProxyManager
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: Primeli
description:
vProxyManager is a client-side proxy manager for Fabric.
It lets you import and manage SOCKS/HTTP proxies, organize them into groups, test their status, and assign specific proxy rules per multiplayer server.
